Content: Material cycles are necessary to recycle substances needed and used by organisms in their habitat.

The atmosphere is composed of about `80%` nitrogen gas (`text(N)_2`) that cannot be used by most organisms in that form. It is through the action of many different types of bacteria that the nitrogen gas can be made available to other organisms.
